title: The query log detects a false none from a routed answer's urls

notes: The store never keeps the answer text (ql_distill.entry_of: Haiku judges the reply, which is never stored), so the urls are the pages the lookup's session fetched: a kb: or kb_pack lookup routed web researches in the session, and its WebFetch and docs-server fetches are stored as host and path (querylog.md, Surfaces). kb_ask.py's own claude -p runs with hooks off (querylog.md, Spool), so its lookups need TK-if7de5pb “kb_ask.py rows carry the kb sources its researcher cites”, behind gate `record`. agent_bench.norm_url is the normaliser to follow, plus a trailing `.md` (S743's url is https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks.md). TestLearn and querylog.py check pass now: they guard the existing findings and the store gates.
